text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A veritable mountain of plushies, all<n>for me. Thank
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I feel not only happy, but also<n>strangely at
peace. I can't help but<n>smile.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting this soft, warm<n>feeling—and not just
from the<n>plushies themselves.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because... this gift came<n>from the
heart.
